arguments.name: array
arguments.type: previously dimensioned one- or two-dimensional floating-point field

semantics.summary: Reads a vector or matrix from an ASCII file using the reverse of MAT PRINT's format; commas and rowfeeds may vary as with INPUT #.
side-effects: Reads from the selected open file channel and writes values into the supplied field.

notes: The addendum explicitly describes ASCII input and flexible commas/rowfeeds.

The printed page images were visually checked; this declaration is still marked book-documented because its behavior has not been independently cross-checked against a second primary witness or observed runtime.
